questions.text: Is the Monday pipeline overview the one problem we scope, or the monthly management figures?
questions.hint: Proposal must center on one problem.

questions.text: Can we quote the four hours every Friday as the current manual time cost?
Do all eight reps use the same Excel column structure, or does each sheet differ?
questions.hint: Determines how much mapping work the dashboard needs.

questions.text: How do we get the reps' Excel files: shared drive, email, or something else?
questions.hint: Decides the data-collection method for the dashboard.

questions.text: What single number proves success: hours saved per week, or Monday-morning freshness?
questions.hint: Sharpens the measurable result in the proposal.

questions.text: Are the reps willing to keep filling their own Excel sheet unchanged for now?
questions.hint: The no-CRM promise depends on this.
